Sec. 1.3.6 (pp. 5-6) Lohar caste and sec. 1.4.6 (pp. 10-11) Lohari language (ca. 85 households, ~500 speakers; alt. names Gara, Domba, Dombiali; 'Indo-Aryan, Unclassified'); pp. 16-17 Table 9 lexical similarity (two Lohari samples 82% with each other, 73% with Chinali). Appendix A.4 gives two 210-item Lohari wordlists (Lo, Gondhla; Lo, Gawzang) in IPA field transcription with no stress marks at all (zero occurrences of the IPA stress mark in the whole report); p. 40 says the wordlists 'are field transcriptions and have not undergone thorough phonological and grammatical analysis'.
